key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week amid rate-rise fears and oil price surge, signalling sharp risk-off rotation
Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX valuations
AUD smashed on growth scare; oil spike (price suppression failure) threatens inflation and RBA path
ANZ.AX restructuring after 3,500 job cuts signals ongoing financial sector cost pressure
Australian fuel prices set to rise 30c, squeezing consumer and transport margins
Mining cap-raise wave led by Canaccord signals capital stress in junior resources
No spring bounce in auction market; house price correction concerns persist for REITs
Santos preservation deal raises questions on energy sector consolidation and shareholder returns

sectors.trend: Iron ore in active 'bloodletting' phase; gold weak ('schmould'); junior miners scrambling for cap raises via Canaccord-led dash. Whyalla blast furnace call threatens steel supply chain.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. Gold miners (NEM.AX, GRC.AX) lack safe-haven bid. Junior miners (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) volatile but speculative. Steel/industrial names under pressure.

sectors.trend: ANZ.AX post-restructuring (3,500 cuts) still has 'long way to go'; superannuation system under political scrutiny; tax burden on households constrains credit demand.
sectors.implications: Big Four banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX) face margin pressure from rate sensitivity and consumer stress. Super fund managers (HUB.AX, PPA.AX) face policy risk. Credit growth may decelerate.

sectors.trend: Oil 'explodes' as price suppression fails; Australian fuel +30c; Santos preservation deal signals government intervention in energy consolidation. Hyper-scale data centre could draw 25% of QLD power.
sectors.implications: SOL.AX, WDS.AX, AWE.AX benefit from oil spike but face input cost pass-through. Energy infrastructure (SGH.AX, IAG.AX) gains from data centre demand. Airlines (QAN.AX) hit by fuel costs and staffing (1 in 3 flights cancelled).

sectors.trend: No auction bounce; house prices under downward pressure; businesses 'fear for their future'; tax burden rising. NZ housing correction still running.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (VCG.AX, DGP.AX, ICPS.AX) face occupancy and valuation headwinds. Consumer discretionary (WES.AX, WBC.AX retail) pressured by fuel and tax. Defensive staples (WOW.AX, WES.AX) relatively resilient.

sectors.trend: AI 'doomsday' debate (Anthropic slowdown call vs Trump pushback); hyper-scale data centre in QLD; ASX small-caps (Iondrive, Neurizon) showing momentum.
sectors.implications: ASX tech exposure limited but data centre build-out benefits energy and construction. Global AI volatility (NVDA, AMD) transmits via sentiment. Small-cap tech (NEU.AX) speculative.

key_themes: Oil-driven inflation scare threatening RBA easing cycle and global rate path
Iron ore structural demand question (China slowdown) triggering commodity 'bloodletting'
AUD weakness amplifying import costs and consumer squeeze
Mining sector capital stress: cap raises signal balance sheet fragility in juniors
Housing correction extending; no demand inflection in auctions
Energy policy intervention (Santos) reshaping sector consolidation dynamics
AI regulatory/debate overhang creating volatility in global tech, limited ASX direct impact
Migration policy uncertainty (One Nation 750k cut proposal) affecting labour supply and construction

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike reigniting inflation and forcing RBA to hold/hike rates
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour rate-sensitive defensives; monitor RBA statement and CPI print

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price collapse compressing ASX 200 mining earnings
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate to gold or energy; monitor China PMI

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD depreciation triggering capital outflows and import-cost inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour domestic-revenue companies; avoid high-import-cost sectors; consider AUD-hedged positions

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction deepening, pressuring REITs and construction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight property REITs; favour income-yielding staples; monitor auction clearance rates

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mining junior cap-raise dilution and capital stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid speculative juniors; favour cash-flow-positive producers; monitor Canaccord deal flow

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Airline/transport cost shock from fuel and staffing
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight QAN.AX; monitor fuel hedge ratios and capacity data

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy producers benefiting from oil spike
opportunities.rationale: Oil 'explosion' and failed price suppression create near-term margin upside for upstream names; fuel cost pass-through supports downstream

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into defensive consumer staples and healthcare
opportunities.rationale: Consumer squeeze from fuel, tax, and rate fears favours inelastic-demand names; CSL.AX provides global diversification

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to data centre / energy infrastructure
opportunities.rationale: Hyper-scale QLD data centre (25% of state power) drives long-term demand for power generation and grid infrastructure

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce or hedge ASX 200 mining exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' and $90bn ASX drawdown signal structural demand risk; gold also weak
No auction bounce, house price correction extending, NZ correction still running; occupancy and cap-rate risk elevated
Fuel +30c, 1-in-3 flight cancellations, staffing crisis compress margins; QAN.AX vulnerable

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash or short-duration bonds as AUD weakens
defensive_moves.rationale: Growth scare and oil-driven inflation create stagflation risk; AUD weakness favours domestic fixed income

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to extend $90bn drawdown as oil-driven inflation fears and iron ore weakness dominate. RBA caught between growth scare and sticky energy inflation. AUD weakness amplifies import costs. Expect elevated volatility into Fed meeting. Mining and property under pressure; energy and defensives relative outperformers.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive if oil stabilises and iron ore finds a floor. Data centre build-out and energy transition provide structural demand. Superannuation system reform debate could create policy tailwinds for fund managers. Housing correction likely to complete within 6-12 months, setting up REIT recovery. Key variable: China demand trajectory for iron ore and LNG.
